method: Intersect original indexed triangles with horizontal planes below an interpreted body seat. Weld 2D segment vertices at 0.00001 mm. Compare unnumbered terminal sections to original and current PCB drill positions, without rescaling or fitting a translation.

frame.basis: Keep original XYZ directions; subtract observed mouth-axis X, front-face Y and housing-bottom Z only. Positive Y points rearward into the housing.
frame.evidence: Axis from circular front sleeve ID178 bounding-box center; front from minimum Y; body seat from group_3 housing lowest shared plane. Generic node names do not independently verify these physical roles.

selected_rigid_front_anchor_screen.meaning: Nominal mesh-section corner intersections with drill boundaries under one interpreted rigid front registration. This is not a claim that the historical physical part cannot fit.

possible_common_axial_datum_difference.interpretation: The common 0.2 mm row offset could follow a different flange or front-seat datum in this older export. The same 0.2 mm difference exists between its 2.0 mm flange depth and the current drawing's 1.8 mm depth. This does not establish a required translation or historical part pose. No alternate registration was applied or tested.

locator_review.interpretation: Only seven terminal-like sections were observed below the selected body plane. No additional distinct plastic locator projection was identified. Generic CAD names and materials do not prove the absence of a locator on the actual part.

limits: Low-Z section clusters identify terminal geometry, not electrical pin numbers. Nearest-pad associations are geometric hypotheses only.
Body and front datums require interpretation. No optimized rigid fit, mirrored fit or nominal scaling was performed. This single registration cannot establish physical misfit.
A closed 2D section loop does not prove 3D mesh manifoldness, actual pin forming, plating clearance or physical seating.

Two front terminal tips taper from 0.4 x 0.3 to 1.0 x 0.3 mm around Z = -3.3 to -3.0 mm. The nominal 1.6 mm PCB engagement region lies above that tip chamfer. Five other terminal sections measure 0.5 x 1.0 mm. No assumed bowing, elastic deflection or extra narrowing was credited.

Original imperial-grid pad positions, current family drawing revision, front-seat datum, mesh precision and real forming and manufacturing tolerances remain unqualified for fit. The lateral differences also remain: model X = +/-7.5 and +/-5.0 mm versus original/PCB outer centers -7.52/+7.62 and +/-5.08 mm. Nominal section screening cannot certify physical fit.
